04] System audio: We tried a whiteboard with a number on it for a month. It was wrong most of the time, so we took it down.

[10:08:43] Microphone: Who decided to take it down?

[10:09:06] System audio: The charge nurse did. She said a wrong number was worse than no number, and I agree with her.

[10:09:36] Microphone: That is really helpful. Is there anyone else you think we should talk to?

[10:10:13] System audio: Talk to our charge nurse. She has been here eleven years and has opinions about all of it.

[10:10:34] Microphone: We will. Thank you again for your time.

[10:11:02] System audio: You are welcome. Good luck with it.
